notes: Account: SignalPath (mid-market SaaS analytics) - product teams building in-app support and knowledge features.
Initial interest started on hosted API for embeddings/doc search; shifted to Dedicated after seeing production throughput needs.
VP Product quote: "We need sub-200ms p50 for chat in EU, and p99 < 350ms for core support flows."
Infra lead: highly cost-sensitive vs OpenAI; wants clear unit economics for Dedicated (batching/caching impact).
POC success criteria: 1) meet p99 latency targets for 95% of requests, 2) canary rollout with zero user-facing errors, 3) automated region failover within 60s, 4) rollback without data loss.
Routing plan in POC: primary model = quantized LLM-v2 (optimized), canary variant = LLM-v2-fp16 in same region, fallback = smaller LLM-compact in cheaper capacity.
Region failover plan: primary US-east, secondary EU-west; test cross-region cache consistency and impact on latency.
Rollback plan: automatic traffic cutover to previous model variant + instant routing to Dedicated reserve pool, follow runbook INFRA-342.
Security: require SSO (SAML), audit logs retained 1 year, KMS-managed keys, and data residency for EU customer records.
Observed during demo: Redwood batch/caching suggestions reduced token cost estimate by ~30% for their workload (estimations in pricing-deck).
Legal: asked for contractual language around data deletion, residency, and SOC2 attestation. Assigned ticket SEC-128.
